title: MTG Reality Fracture Bundle — Play Boosters, Foil Basic Lands, Promo & Spindown (English Edition)
description:
The MTG Reality Fracture Bundle is the set's standard Play Booster Bundle in one box: 9 Reality Fracture Play Boosters, 30 basic lands (15 traditional foil and 15 non-foil), a traditional foil alt-art promo card, an oversized Spindown life counter and a card storage box that holds everything.

This is the standard Bundle, not the Gift Bundle, so it does not include a Collector Booster. One sealed Bundle, English edition.

title: MTG The Hobbit Gift Bundle
description:
The MTG The Hobbit Gift Bundle is the gift-packaged edition of the set's Bundle. It holds 9 The Hobbit Play Boosters and 1 The Hobbit Collector Booster, 30 basic lands (15 traditional foil and 15 non-foil), a traditional foil alt-art promo card, an oversized Spindown life counter and a card storage box, all in gift packaging.

It differs from the standard MTG The Hobbit Bundle (a separate listing) by adding the Collector Booster and the gift presentation. One sealed Gift Bundle, English edition.
